title: Composition
description:
A car **has an** engine: the engine is a part of the car, is created with it and destroyed with it. In code that is simply a member variable.

The `Engine` class is provided. Write a class `Car` that contains one as a member and offers:

- `void turnKey()`: starts the engine,
- `bool drive()`: returns `true` and adds 10 km to the odometer if the engine is running; otherwise returns `false` and does nothing,
- `void park()`: stops the engine,
- `int odometer() const`.
hints: Make the `Engine` a plain member: `Engine m_engine;`. It is created and destroyed together with the car.
`drive()` asks the engine whether it is running before adding 10 to the odometer.
